sources.title: Introducing Macaron-V1
sources.snippet: Macaron-V1 is Mind Lab's agent model in 748B Venti and 35B Tall variants, built on Mixture-of-LoRA and model-harness co-design.

sources.snippet: Macaron-V1-Tall is a Mixture of LoRA (MoL) model in the Macaron-V1 family, built on Qwen3.6-35B-A3B for personal intelligence, tool use, coding workflows, and code-native Generative UI.
